title: Enumeration of dislocation reaction counts
action: Write a program that for each Σ ∈ {3,5,7,9,11,13} computes the DSC vectors for fcc and primitive‑cubic lattices; tests absorption (30 tests) and transmission/transformation (1800 tests) using the King & Chen criteria against both DSC sets; counts allowed reactions; and writes reaction_counts.csv with columns sigma, condition, absorption_count, transmission_count.
description: Table of allowed absorption and transmission counts for each Σ, for disordered (fcc‑DSC) and ordered (primitive‑cubic DSC) boundaries.
output_schema: Columns: sigma (integer), condition (string, 'disordered' or 'ordered'), absorption_count (integer), transmission_count (integer).
